def: An open-source Python library, grown out of the Sentence-BERT paper (Reimers and Gurevych, 2019), for computing and fine-tuning embedding models, cross-encoder rerankers and sparse encoders.
practice: A standard way to run open embedders and fine-tune them on your own pairs with losses such as MultipleNegativesRankingLoss; maintained by Hugging Face as of November 2026.
